Webbed_Frogfish_Graspers.description: The Webbed_Frogfish_Graspers are powerful, piscine appendages that resemble the grasping tentacles of deep-sea frogfish, enhancing both underwater traversal and combat prowess with their strength and agility, allowing for formidable grappling and swift, powerful dashes through water.

Pungent_Lionfish_Spiked_Arms.description: Bristling with venomous spines and razor-sharp fins, the Pungent Lionfish Spiked Arms grant their wielder an eerie aquatic grace and a deadly arsenal of slashing attacks, accompanied by a toxic cloud that lingers in their wake to sap the vitality of any who dare approach.

Slippery_Eel_Coiling_Arms.description: These sinuous, piscine arms shimmer with a slick, almost ethereal sheen, their rapid, fluid movements granting unparalleled agility and the ability to effortlessly grapple foes, while also allowing the user to traverse through water as nimbly as on solid ground.

Heavy_Coelacanth_Lobe_Arms.description: The Heavy Coelacanth Lobe Arms are thick, muscular appendages that resemble the ancient lobe-finned fish, their scales providing a natural armor that protects against even the sharpest of blades, while their immense strength allows the wielder to block attacks with ease and knock down foes with a single strike.

Camouflaging_Flounder_Flat_Arms.description: These piscine appendages, resembling the flattened bodies of a flounder, allow their wielder to seamlessly blend into aquatic environments, enhancing their stealth and agility as they glide through water with effortless grace, completely ignoring the resistance of varied terrain.

Bioluminescent_Viperfish_Claws.description: Equipped with the Bioluminescent Viperfish Claws, a player's arms transform into sleek, sinuous appendages that glow with an eerie, otherworldly light, enhancing their perception and agility in dark waters, while granting them the ability to inflict bleeding wounds and cast a faint light to navigate the murky depths.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Arms.description: Emerging from the depths of an ancient, cursed pond, the Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Arms are spectral tendrils that mimic the undulating motion of a koi fish, granting their wielder unparalleled stealth and evasion as they glide through both water and air, leaving no trace behind.

Electric_Ray_Shocking_Graspers.description: Emerging from the abyssal depths, the Electric Ray Shocking Graspers are piscine appendages that shimmer with a lethal charge, capable of ensnaring foes with electrifying precision and agility, their fluid movements complemented by an innate magic that can deflect hostile spells back upon their origin.

Streamlined_Shark_Pectoral_Arms.description: These sinuous, piscine arms, finned like those of a sleek shark, grant unparalleled agility and speed in water, enabling the user to perform dazzling acrobatics and swift dashes beneath the waves.

Armored_Sturgeon_Spiked_Forearms.description: Enormous, piscine forearms bristling with sharp spines and encased in bony armor, these formidable appendages grant their bearer unparalleled strength and resilience, allowing them to effortlessly block attacks and cleave through even the toughest of defenses.
